caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling an ornate metallic tool or decorative piece, rendered in shades of brown and gold. The object is vertically oriented and consists of a flat, oval central section bordered by two symmetrical, curved supports that arc outward near the bottom. At the top, there is a circular loop with a decorative scroll extending upward and culminating in a stylized, leafy, or floral shape. The main surface of the object has faint linear and leafy patterns, suggesting filigree or engraved designs. The supports at the sides each have a spiral motif with a small circular detail, and two prongs extend downward, one from each side at the bottom. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, highlighting the object and its details.
title: Patch-box from Cavalry Carbine Stock
